## 暂缓的非活动分支

这些分支不计入本阶段69个active入口及BFB完成率；切换到能实际执行该分支的专用case后另组验证。

| 过程/分支 | Host | 状态 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flux_avg_run` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | Current PI case uses srf_flux_avg=0; it needs a dedicated active configuration. |
| `tracers_timestep_tend / aoa_tracers_timestep_tend` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | Test and age-of-air tracers are disabled in the current PI case. |
| `CARMA emissions / cloud / wetdep / drydep` | tphysac, tphysbc | `deferred_inactive` | CARMA resolves to inactive/no-op paths in the current PI configuration. |
| `CLUBB surface / macrophysics / shallow convection` | tphysac, tphysbc | `deferred_inactive` | do_clubb=false; no execution proof is possible in the current PI case. |
| `RK stratiform_tend` | tphysbc | `deferred_inactive` | The active microphysics is MG1.0 rather than Rasch-Kristjansson. |
| `subcolumn microphysics` | tphysbc | `deferred_inactive` | Subcolumn mode is disabled in the current PI case. |
| `mspd_intr / WACCM-X` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | WACCM-X is disabled. |
| `rayleigh_friction_tend` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | The call is present but configured with no physical effect (raytau0=0). |
| `qbo_relax` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | QBO relaxation is disabled in the current PI case. |
| `iondrag_calc / ionos_tend` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | Ionosphere and ion-drag paths are disabled/stubbed. |
| `unicon_cam_org_diags` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | UNICON is not the active convection package. |
| `physics_dme_adjust` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | The current SE path returns immediately; it cannot provide meaningful execution proof. |
| `sslt_rebin_adv` | tphysbc | `deferred_inactive` | This branch does not execute in the current PI configuration. |
| `clybry_fam_adj / clybry_fam_set` | tphysac, tphysbc | `deferred_inactive` | The current chemistry mechanism makes the CLY/BRY family hooks no-op. |
| `charge_fix` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | The active mechanism does not exercise a substantive charge-fix path. |
| `non-orographic gravity-wave sources` | tphysac | `deferred_inactive` | Only orographic gravity-wave drag is enabled for this campaign. |
| `hetfrz / ndrop_bam alternatives` | tphysbc | `deferred_inactive` | These alternative activation/freezing branches are not selected by the current PI namelist. |
